question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**crawling**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context tells us that velvety ladybirds, centipedes, and wriggling worms were all over the muddy ground.
 
• Since worms and centipedes move by **crawling**, this word appropriately describes their motion on the muddy ground.
 
• "**Crawling**" (घिसटना) fits well as it denotes the movement of worms.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.
